evals.prompt: `make start` hangs and Publish never answers on 4503. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Gives commands for the user to run, uses make health and make logs-publish, never suggests kill -9.
expectations: The response gives commands for the user to run rather than running them itself
The response uses `make health` to check the services
The response uses `make logs-publish` to read the Publish log
The response never suggests `kill -9`

evals.expected_output: Edits CUSTOM_DOMAINS in .env, then make certs FORCE=1, make nginx, make hosts. No hardcoded domain in scripts.
expectations: The response edits `CUSTOM_DOMAINS` in `.env` to add the domain
The response runs `make certs FORCE=1` after the edit
The response runs `make nginx` after the edit
The response runs `make hosts` after the edit
The response does not hardcode the domain in any script

evals.prompt: I have no sudo on this laptop. How do I reach the sites?
evals.expected_output: make browser-no-admin, Chrome or Edge only, Safari still needs make hosts.
expectations: The response recommends `make browser-no-admin`
The response says it works with Chrome or Edge only
The response says Safari still needs `make hosts`

evals.prompt: Use my project repo's dispatcher/src instead of the seeded one.
evals.expected_output: Sets DISPATCHER_SRC_DIR, says the directory must already exist, says uninstall never deletes it.
expectations: The response sets `DISPATCHER_SRC_DIR`
The response says the directory must already exist
The response says uninstall never deletes it

evals.prompt: AEM will not stop. Can I just kill -9 it?
evals.expected_output: Refuses, explains Oak repository damage, offers make stop-aem, which waits with no timeout.
expectations: The response refuses `kill -9`
The response explains the risk of Oak repository damage
The response offers `make stop-aem`
The response says `make stop-aem` waits with no timeout

evals.prompt: Add a Redis stack to make.
evals.expected_output: mk/redis.mk auto-included, sources scripts/lib/common.sh, covers mac, linux and windows.
expectations: The response puts the stack in `mk/redis.mk`, auto-included by the Makefile
The response's scripts source `scripts/lib/common.sh`
The response covers mac, linux and windows

evals.prompt: I have Java 17. Will the quickstart run?
expectations: The response says no, the quickstart will not run on Java 17
The response says Java 21+ is required
The response names `JAVA_REQUIRED` in `.env`

evals.prompt: Set up the Magento test stack.
evals.expected_output: Says the stack was removed, invents no script.
expectations: The response says the Magento stack was removed
The response invents no script

evals.prompt: Write a Python function that dedupes a list, keeping order.
expectations: The response contains no AEM content
The response contains no AEM content
